name: Hearthwater orchard third-person
expression: async()=>{document.querySelector('[data-rpg="camera"][data-id="follow"]').click();const walk=async(x,z)=>{const r=Realm.test.move(x,z);if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);const start=performance.now();while(Realm.test.path.length){if(performance.now()-start>60000)throw Error('walk timeout');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}};await walk(0,23);document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'e',bubbles:true}));document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{key:'e',bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('[data-rpg=earth-confirm]').click();await walk(-13,1);Realm.test.view({yaw:1.8,elevation:.32,distance:8});Realm.test.render();return Realm.diagnostics.scene}
